proposal.summary: The cart total summed each product's unit price once instead of multiplying by quantity, so three items totaled as one; the change multiplies price units and nanos by quantity when computing the total.

reasons: The patch fixes the repeated cart-check failure by multiplying both price units and nanos by quantity, so three items at $101.96 plus $26.97 shipping total $332.85 instead of $128.93.
It is the smallest targeted change, altering only the two total calculations in CartItems.tsx.
Shipping and the nanos-to-units carry remain handled by the existing unchanged logic, so no visible surrounding behavior is broken.
The find string matches the provided CartItems.tsx source exactly once.
